note: The plan requires every constant in those two files to be resolvable through the Config Service (Phase 1 completion criterion). They are registered here under a `legacy.` prefix with their owning phase's replacement named, because they belong to the legacy dispatcher and are replaced — not re-tuned — when their phase lands. `legacy.dtaro.*` are percentage battery floors; §14.1 states that percentage-based floors are inadequate and §14.5 replaces them with Wh-denominated layered reserves in Phase 7. The values here are the values the legacy path runs today, unchanged: Phase 1 moves where they live, not what they are.

parameters.name: legacy.dtaro.battery_threshold_pct
parameters.awaits: replacement by the Wh-denominated layered reserve model

legacy.retirementNote: PHASE 15 — robotValidator.service.js was retired with the legacy decision path. Its eligibility judgement is now the F01..F38 predicate register evaluated by feasibility/evaluate.js (§7), and the battery half of it is F34, whose targets derive from the governed fleet-year event budget rather than from a percentage (§14.1, §14.5).

parameters.description: Minimum battery percentage a robot must have to be DTARO-eligible for a new task, and the floor used when deciding whether a charging robot may be assigned one. A percentage floor cannot express a tail requirement and is replaced, not re-tuned, in Phase 7.

parameters.name: legacy.dtaro.charging_interrupt_battery_pct
parameters.awaits: replacement by the charge-curve and target-SoC model

legacy.retirementNote: PHASE 15 — robotValidator.service.js was retired with the legacy decision path. Its eligibility judgement is now the F01..F38 predicate register evaluated by feasibility/evaluate.js (§7), and the battery half of it is F34, whose targets derive from the governed fleet-year event budget rather than from a percentage (§14.1, §14.5).

parameters.description: Minimum battery percentage a charging VirtualRobot needs before it will interrupt charging to start an already-assigned task rather than deferring it.

parameters.name: legacy.liveness.db_flush_interval_ms
parameters.description: Throttle on Robot.lastSeenAt writes from the heartbeat and telemetry handlers. Coupled to the offline cutoff: if it approached the cutoff, the margin for a slow write or a delayed tick would disappear.

parameters.name: legacy.liveness.offline_cutoff_ms
parameters.description: How stale lastSeenAt must be before the offline sweep marks a robot OFFLINE. Must exceed the flush interval, or a healthy robot flaps offline in the gap between two throttled writes.

parameters.name: legacy.liveness.offline_sweep_interval_ms
parameters.awaits: absorption into the reconciler's periodic sweep
parameters.description: How often the legacy offline sweep runs. The sweep is a backstop, not the primary offline signal, so its latency is not user-visible.

parameters.name: legacy.liveness.offline_sweep_batch
parameters.awaits: absorption into the reconciler's periodic sweep
parameters.description: Maximum robots examined per sweep pass — bounds the blast radius of one tick.
